data.exact_reserve_text: The 2013 and prior years produced a net profit of GBP 3,648k, following better than expected claims activity, particularly in the Professional Indemnity and General Liability classes.

prior_year_events.event_name: 100% reinsurance of certain long tail outstanding claims on 2014 and prior underwriting years
prior_year_events.impact_description: Entered into transaction providing 100% reinsurance of certain long tail outstanding claims on 2014 and prior underwriting years; removes reserve uncertainty applicable to the reinsured claims and due to be followed by legal transfer of the underlying claims to the reinsurer.

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss Portfolio Transfer Agreement (2007 and prior)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Cost of the 2007 and prior year Loss Portfolio Transfer Agreement included in the result; transferred 100% of the Syndicate's economic liability in the reinsured portfolio to an external reinsurer by way of 100% quota share reinsurance, providing future protection from potential downside risk from long tail disease exposure.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves at the opening of the year were GBP 1,063.737m. Analysis of development on prior underwriting years (2014 and earlier) shows no net movement in the available claims development table (net basis), i.e. effectively flat prior-year development. The 2013 and prior years produced a modest net favourable outcome attributed to better-than-expected claims activity, notably in Professional Indemnity and General Liability. During the year the syndicate undertook transactions (including a 100% reinsurance of certain long-tail 2014-and-prior claims and a loss portfolio transfer affecting 2007-and-prior reserves) which removed reserve uncertainty on those portfolios.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2013 and prior years produced a net profit of GBP 3,648k, following better than expected claims activity, particularly in the Professional Indemnity and General Liability classes.

During the year the Syndicate entered into a significant transaction with a third party organisation, whereby, in return for a reinsurance premium, the Syndicate benefits from 100% reinsurance of certain long tail outstanding claims on 2014 and prior underwriting years. This policy removes reserve uncertainty applicable to the reinsured claims, and is due to be followed by legal transfer of the underlying claims to the reinsurer.

cost of the 2007 and prior year Loss Portfolio Transfer Agreement in respect of the Syndicate's UK & Ireland EL and PL legacy reserves. This agreement transferred 100% of the Syndicate's economic liability in the reinsured portfolio to an external reinsurer by way of 100% quota share reinsurance, providing future protection from any potential downside risk from long tail disease exposure.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year (2014-and-earlier) movement figure was disclosed. A net claims development triangle (note 15) was used as the fallback source and shows no net movement for underwriting years 2014. The triangle is presented on a net (after reinsurance) basis; therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m is derived from net data rather than gross and may not reflect gross movement. Additionally, reinsurance transactions (100% reinsurance of certain long-tail 2014-and-prior claims and a Loss Portfolio Transfer for 2007-and-prior) occurred during the year and may distort development analysis.
